### Too Tired to Pray
Author: Wendy Pope
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-6-2012.html
Passage: Nehemiah 2:4
Points:
- Relentless challenges and repeated setbacks can leave believers emotionally drained and feeling too tired to pray.
- When facing the ruined state of Jerusalem and ongoing opposition, Nehemiah consistently responded to obstacles through prayer.
- Calling on the God of heaven revitalized Nehemiah's spirit and provided the strength needed to carry out his mission.
- Believers are urged to "stop and pray" in every circumstance, treating prayer as their first response rather than an exhausted last resort.

### Power Point - May 10, 2005
Author: Jack Graham (PowerPoint Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-may-10-2005-1329213.html
Passage: Nehemiah 2:4-5
Points:
- Hearing of Jerusalem's devastated walls drove Nehemiah to his knees in brokenness, weeping, and earnest prayer before God.
- Through that time of prayer, God planted a bold vision in Nehemiah's heart to rebuild the city and restore the people.
- Effective spiritual leaders look beyond current ruins to envision what God wants to accomplish.
- Fulfilling God's vision requires a commitment to pray, process the plan, and actively pursue it with daily perseverance.
